# fastly_product_ai_accelerator (Resource)

Enables AI Accelerator for the account. Destroying this resource disables the product.



## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether AI Accelerator is enabled for the account. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource (always `ai_accelerator`).
